sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, Slime Matching is a match-three puzzle game. Players are presented with a grid of colored slime, and their goal is to match as many colors as possible within a limited time frame. The game becomes increasingly challenging as players progress through the levels, requiring them to think on their feet and strategize their moves.

The game's core gameplay mechanics are simple yet engaging. Players can move the slime tiles around the grid to create sets of three or more identical colors. When a set of three or more identical colors is created, they disappear, and new tiles are added to the grid. The game continues until the time runs out or the grid is completely filled with slime.

One of the key features of Slime Matching is its use of power-ups and bonuses.
